### Fixed
- **`muster agent --mcp-server` no longer loses a tool's answer behind a notification.** The bridge opens no standalone GET stream, so every notification the aggregator sends its session -- `notifications/tools/list_changed` as SSO connections are established at connect, as the person's session connects further servers, as a backend re-lists -- is written onto the response stream of the `call_tool` in flight, ahead of the result. The bridge's transport handed each one to `Client.NotificationChan` with a blocking send on the goroutine that reads that stream; the channel holds ten and nothing read it in this mode, so the eleventh notification of the process's life stopped the reader in front of the call's result and the call ended in the bridge's timeout (`Meta-tool execution failed: tool call failed: transport error: context deadline exceeded`) while the aggregator had answered in seconds -- giantswarm-platform-manager's `platformctl installation verify` lost the live half of every verify of the hub that way. The hand-off never waits now (a notification the queue has no room for is dropped and logged; a `list_changed` is a signal to re-list, one queued stands for all that follow), and in `--mcp-server` mode the bridge reads the queue, lets its caches follow a `list_changed` and relays the aggregator's `list_changed` notifications to the assistant as its own, which its `tools.listChanged` capability promised -- after the pending-auth upgrade too. ([#1309](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1309))
